tagline.en_US: RabbitMQ routes messages between services using AMQP and other protocols. This single-node profile uses the official management image, a persistent data volume and a generated administrator password; it does not include cluster nodes or application producers and consumers.

description.en_US: RabbitMQ is a multi-protocol messaging and streaming broker. It enables applications and services to communicate asynchronously by routing messages through queues and streams. It supports numerous standard protocols including AMQP, MQTT, and STOMP.
